q: The police caught the ______ who stole expensive clothes from the downtown boutique.
why: «boutique» va kiyim o'g'irlash do'kon o'g'risini bildiradi.

q: Someone intentionally poured petrol on the old abandoned school and burned it down.
why: «burned it down» qasddan o't qo'yish jinoyatini anglatadi.

wrong.vandalism: Mulkka zarar yetkazish, yoqib yuborish emas.

q: An unknown ______ attacked an elderly woman in the dark park and stole her bag.
why: «attacked an elderly woman in the dark park» ko'chada hujum qiluvchi bosqinchini bildiradi.

q: The criminal was found guilty of taking a human life during the bank raid.
why: «taking a human life» bu qotillik jinoyatidir.

q: The police arrested a notorious ______ who was selling illegal substances near the school.
why: «selling illegal substances» giyohvand moddalar sotuvchisini bildiradi.

q: During the riot, people broke shop windows and stole televisions and electronics from the stores.
why: «during the riot» va do'konlardan mol talash tartibsizlik vaqtidagi talonchilikdir.

q: Teenagers painted ugly graffiti on the historic monument and broke the glass of the bus stop.
why: «painted ugly graffiti» va avtobus bekatini sindirish mulkka zarar yetkazishdir.

q: Border guards found hidden gold inside the car seats of the clever ______.
why: «hidden gold inside the car seats» chegaradan yashirin tovar olib o'tuvchini anglatadi.

q: The person who committed the arson attack on the warehouse was finally caught by police.
why: «committed the arson attack» o't qo'yuvchi jinoyatchini bildiradi.

q: A dangerous ______ escaped from prison after killing two security guards.
why: «killing two security guards» odam o'ldirgan qotilni bildiradi.

q: The armed men who stole money from the jewelry store were arrested within an hour.
why: Zargarlik do'konidan qurol ishlatib pul olganlar bosqinchilar («robbers»).

q: The local council wants to ______ the old walls with colourful modern art.
why: Devorlarga zamonaviy san'at asarlarini chizish yoki buzish ma'nosida ishlatiladi.

q: Someone took my bicycle from the school yard while I was having my math lesson.
why: Velosipedning yashirincha o'g'irlanishi bu oddiy o'g'rilik («theft»).

q: Be careful not to leave your car unlocked, or someone might ______ your radio.
why: «your radio» narsani o'g'irlash fe'lini talab qiladi.

q: The hooligans decided to put petrol under the wooden shed and start a huge fire.
why: «start a huge fire» o't qo'yish ma'nosini bildiradi.

q: The thieves tried to ______ the back door of the shop using a heavy metal tool.
why: «the back door» eshikni sindirib ochish ma'nosiga mos keladi.

q: The illegal business of buying and selling forbidden drugs ruined many young lives.
why: «buying and selling forbidden drugs» giyohvand moddalar savdosini bildiradi.

q: Do not leave your bag on the bench, someone might ______ you in broad daylight.
why: «you» shaxsga qaratilgan talonchilik fe'lini talab qiladi.

q: The merchant tried to offer illegal items to customers under the table.
why: Taqiqlangan narsalarni yashirincha o'tkazish kontrabandadir.

q: He was sent to prison for trying to ______ stolen antiques to a rich collector.
why: «stolen antiques to a rich collector» o'g'irlangan buyumlarni sotishni bildiradi.
